name: Welsh
source:
A young man who runs a bakery in the border town of Avic. He is a childhood friend (?) who has played with Alice several times in the past.

He has a bright and lively personality, and is a caring older brother with a good temperament. He can't help but feed a hungry child.

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/midorino_himegimi.html#chara]official website[/url]]
